entities.summary: Barbara Pickersgill is a British botanist with a special interest in the domestication of crops, the genetics, taxonomy, and evolutionary biology of cultivated plants, and the preservation of crop diversity. Her 1966 dissertation for the degree of Doctor of Philosophy from Indiana University Bloomington concerned the taxonomy of Capsicum chinense. Her doctoral advisor was Charles B. Heiser.
